description: Ship a UI surface that lets an operator paste a scenario path, see the extracted nodes/edges/leading comments/warnings, view server health (including Node sidecar status), and inspect recent extraction calls.

requirements.description: Ship a UI surface that provides operators with interactive graph exploration and system diagnostics. The UI must support: (1) accepting a scenario path input and triggering extraction, (2) displaying extracted nodes with their kinds, names, and leading_comments, (3) displaying edges with their kinds and endpoints, (4) displaying structured Warnings[] from partial extraction, (5) showing server health status including Node sidecar state from /health, and (6) displaying a log of recent extraction calls with timestamps and outcome. The UI must use Connect-RPC clients exclusively (no direct REST calls).
requirements.title: Graph Explorer and Diagnostics UI

validation.notes: Test node rendering component displays NodeKind, name, and leading_comments correctly
Test edge rendering component displays EdgeKind, source node, and target node
Test warnings panel renders all Warning entries with file, kind, and message fields
Test health status indicator reflects UP/RESTARTING/FAILED states from /health endpoint
Test recent-calls log renders extraction timestamp, path, node count, and outcome
TCG-UI-EXPLORER: UI extraction of a fixture path displays correct node/edge counts matching CLI output
TCG-UI-WARNINGS: UI displays structured warnings when extracting a fixture with intentional parse errors
TCG-UI-HEALTH: UI health panel reflects sidecar RESTARTING state within 5 seconds of a sidecar kill
UI Connect-RPC calls succeed and return data for all supported operations
UI renders a 200-file project graph within 3 seconds of receiving the Extract response
An operator can identify a misconfigured project by reading the warnings panel without consulting logs
An operator can confirm sidecar health without accessing server infrastructure directly

title: Graph Explorer + Diagnostics UI
